verdicts.reason: Both are broken the same way: the S-A-L-E letters have come out of their circles and are scattered (S and A at the sides, L tiny at mid-right, E at bottom-left), so the main 'SALE' message can't be read. The four empty circles hang by themselves, and a shrunken copy of the decoration sits in a cluster at upper-left. B is slightly worse because its circles are also clipped on the right edge, while A keeps them whole.
